newsitem.title: USA: Exxon 110,000 bpd Texas fcc unit hit by lightening.
newsitem.headline: Exxon 110,000 bpd Texas fcc unit hit by lightening.

text.p: Exxon Corp said it shut the 110,000 barrel per day fluid catalytic cracker at its 411,000 bpd Baytown, Texas, refinery after a lightening strike Monday night.
"It ought to be back up soon," said company spokesman Dave Gardner. The affected the unit's instruments rather than its structural integrity, he added.
Gardner said the lightening strike caused no injuries at the facility. He would not comment on the downed unit's effect on other units at the refinery.
NYMEX August gasoline futures rallied sharply early Tuesday to a top at 66.50 cents a gallon, up 1.66 cents.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
